effectSummary.ko: HP가 30% 이하인 적에게 치명 확률 +10%p를 적용합니다. 최종 상한은 75%입니다.
effectSummary.en: Adds +10%p critical chance against enemies at or below 30% HP, capped at 75%.

productionConcept: An enduring finishing instinct emblem: a thick silver arrowhead poised inside the split upper half of a weathered bone skull, a single restrained crimson gleam within the split. The skull is a symbolic relic rather than gore, conveying a decisive final hit.
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: standalone HELLSCRIPT Ranger skill icon. Create one original square 1024 x 1024 PNG with genuine native transparent alpha. Surrounding and internal empty space must be fully transparent. Large readable forms, limited detail, strong shape distinction at 64px. Entire subject including glow and particles must fit inside central 76% of canvas, leaving at least 12% fully transparent margin on all four sides. No lettering, numbers, watermark, border, icon frame, medallion rim, UI panel, floor, cast shadow, scenery, solid backdrop, checkerboard or matte. Do not bake any background; preserve native alpha.
